answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Reaching the inlet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The sparrow holds work receipts rather than names, so the lagoon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
